content.value: The manufacturer of a patent medicine claimed that it was 90% effective in relieving an 20 allergy for a period of 8 hours. In a sample 200 people who had the allergy, the medicine provided relief for 160 people.
(i) Determine whether the manufacturer's claim is legitimate by using 0.01 on the level of significance.
(ii) Find the P value of the test.

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 3rd Year 1st Term Regular Examination, 2022
